author: nonretail_writer
central_thesis: Cool October US inflation data turned the Fed's pause into a peak-rates trade: the Treasury curve bull-flattened (10Y 4.44%, -49 bps over 20 observations) and the dollar index slid to 103.82, lifting duration, banks, small caps, Japan's chip-tool makers and Poland's post-election banks and złoty. The same evidence shows growth cooling (retail sales slipping, Walmart caution, oil down 14.49% over 20 sessions, China property drag, Japan's GDP contraction, Germany's budget shock), so the stance is to own duration and rate-sensitive breadth while staying underweight energy, staples, European autos and China platforms, with cheap volatility as the hedge.
sources_policy: Facts come only from the 2023-11-20 own-date headlines (cited inline with [[nNNNN]]) and the 2023-11-20 market card; no other date's feed, card or draft was read. Headlines are treated as headlines, not article bodies; previews are not used as results; numeric spot-FX levels and returns are not quoted; currency direction comes only from cited headlines; the Argentina runoff result, China's November loan prime rate fixing and other items whose event timing sits at or after the cutoff were left out.
known_ambiguities_omitted: n0263 (Reuters, 'China keeps lending benchmark rates unchanged, as expected'): the November loan prime rate fixing was published on Monday 2023-11-20 Beijing morning, after the 00:00 UTC cutoff, although the item is stamped 2023-11-19; excluded as post-cutoff.

Argentina runoff result items (n0157, n0160, n0161, n0163, n0165, n0166, n0167) carry a 2023-11-19 08:00 stamp that precedes the close of polling and the concession that came late on 2023-11-19 local time, close to the cutoff; omitted as timing-ambiguous.
n1094 (CNBC, 'Cruise CEO Kyle Vogt resigns from GM-owned robotaxi unit'): the resignation was reported late on Sunday US time, possibly after 00:00 UTC; omitted as timing-ambiguous.

n2264 (CNBC, 'Dollar posts steep weekly fall, yen trades below 150') is stamped 2023-11-16 but describes a weekly outcome only complete on 2023-11-17; the Reuters item n1620 dated 2023-11-17 was used instead, without the numeric FX level.
n0024 (The Guardian, RBA hike to 4.35%) is stamped 2023-11-06, before the 2023-11-07 decision; the rate level was not quoted and other RBA items were cited instead.
n0774 (CNBC, Alibaba Hong Kong shares drop 10%) is stamped 2023-11-16 although the Hong Kong session drop occurred on 2023-11-17; Reuters n0772 and card data were used instead.
n1585 (Reuters, 'Japanese yen jumps against dollar') is stamped 2023-11-13 although the yen jump followed US CPI on 2023-11-14; not used.
n1826 (Money.pl, 2024 budget with a record deficit) refers to Ukraine's parliament, not Poland's; not used for Polish fiscal claims.
Italy's Moody's review (n1443 is a preview only): no own-date headline reports the outcome, so neither a result nor a pending event was claimed.
No own-date preview dates Nvidia's quarterly report, Lowe's results, the FOMC minutes or the RBA minutes, so no calendar dates were attached to them.
